title: poetry install --sync attempts to remove itself when poetry is installed to a different venv

labels.name: status/triage
labels.description: This issue needs to be triaged

body:
- **Poetry version**: 1.4.0, 1.3.2, 1.2.2
- **Python version**: 3.8.2 (the os-installed python)
- **OS version and name**: OSX 10.15.7 build 19H2 (catalina, yes, this is a somewhat old version)
- **pyproject.toml**: See repro script here: https://gist.github.com/novas0x2a/98801bb5e82478f8411d8a0a0362fc53

## Issue

I'm seeing a weird problem where poetry attempts to remove itself when `poetry install --sync` is run. However, unlike other examples of this, poetry is _not_ installed into the venv it's attempting to manage. Here's a [link](https://gist.github.com/novas0x2a/98801bb5e82478f8411d8a0a0362fc53) to my repro script.

As you can see from this, poetry is installed into a completely different venv, and it's trying to remove itself. The value of `virtualenvs.in-project` does not matter (i'm just using it for easier cleanup). As mentioned above, it repros on several poetry releases, so it's obviously something somewhat fundamental. I know the system python on OSX is notoriously bad, but I was hoping could direct me more in debugging. Thanks!
